# capi_control_plane_template (Resource)

A control-plane provider's `<CP>ControlPlaneTemplate`, the control plane half of a ClusterClass. CAPI templates are immutable, so this resource works like a launch template: a spec change creates a new object named `<name>-<hash>`, `ref` moves to it, consumers roll out, and older revisions are deleted once nothing references them (a MachineSet keeps the old template during a rollout) beyond `revision_history`. Import with `namespace/object_name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A Talos control-plane template for a ClusterClass.
resource "capi_control_plane_template" "main" {
  name          = "prod"
  namespace     = "capi"
  control_plane = "talos"
  spec = {
    controlPlaneConfig = {
      controlplane = {
        generateType = "controlplane"
        talosVersion = "v1.13"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_plane` (String) Control-plane provider name as clusterctl knows it (`talos`, `kubeadm`). Selects the kind from the installed CRDs when `kind` is unset.
- `name` (String) Logical name. Each revision is the object `<name>-<hash of the spec>`.
- `spec` (Dynamic) The template's inner spec (`spec.template.spec`), as an object with the CRD's camelCase keys. Any change is a new revision; consumers move their `ref` and CAPI rolls the change out.

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations on every revision.
- `api_version` (String) `group/version` of the template kind. Resolved from the installed CRDs at apply when unset; name it (from `data.capi_provider_components`) to render completely at plan.
- `kind` (String) Template kind. Resolved from the provider's CRDs at apply when unset.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on every revision.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace. Default `default`.
- `revision_history` (Number) How many unreferenced older revisions to keep. Referenced revisions are never deleted. Default `1`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `object_name` (String) Name of the current revision's object.
- `ref` (Attributes) Reference to the current revision, for `capi_machine_deployment`, `capi_cluster_class` and `capi_cluster`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ref))
- `revision` (String) Content hash of the current revision.
- `revisions` (Attributes List) Every revision object still present, newest first by name, and what refers to it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--revisions))

<a id="nestedatt--ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ref`

Read-Only:

- `api_group` (String)
- `api_version` (String)
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--revisions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `revisions`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `referenced_by` (List of String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# namespace/object_name of the current revision.
terraform import capi_control_plane_template.main capi/prod-1a2b3c4d
```
